messages:
Tara (Finance): URGENT: customer IonPeak attached two March invoices — one is zeroed out, the other full. AP is holding payment. Can someone pick this up?
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_generation_issue=2 customer_id=ionpeak run=batch_2026_03_10_0200
Ivy (Support): Ticket #5912: https://support.redwood.ai/t/5912 0 PDFs attached; customer says the zero invoice is missing reserved_capacity + VAT.
Sam (Billing Eng): Pulling records now. Invoice IDs in PDFs: 2026-03-10033 and 2026-03-10033-RETRY.
Sam (Billing Eng): Quick DB check:
```sql
select invoice_id, total_cents, line_items_count, batch_run from invoices where customer_id='ionpeak' and invoice_id like '2026-03-10033%';
```
Sam (Billing Eng): Returns: 2026-03-10033 total_cents=0 line_items=1 batch_run=batch_2026_03_10_0200; 2026-03-10033-RETRY total_cents=530000 line_items=7 batch_run=batch_2026_03_10_0200.
Ben (Payments): Capture only on RETRY. No refunds yet.
Tara (Finance): Priority: void the zero invoice, regenerate canonical PDF with an audit note, and prepare credit memo if AP requires. Customer needs corrected docs today PST.
Sam (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) mark 2026-03-10033 status=void 2) add audit note to RETRY and regen PDF 3) backfill any missing ledger lines 4) root cause PR to make writer idempotent (use batch_run + invoice_key upsert).
Priya (Product): We had a small experiment toggled last week that patches promo lines post-generation for some accounts. Pause the rollout?
Sam (Billing Eng): Pausing now. I'll run the void and regen.
billing-bot: Task update: void_invoice job completed invoice=2026-03-10033 actor=sam status=success ts=1900000100
Sam (Billing Eng): Regenerated PDF for 2026-03-10033-RETRY and uploaded to ticket. Audit note: "Duplicate incomplete invoice voided; canonical invoice retained (batch batch_2026_03_10_0200)."
Ivy (Support): Sent PDF to IonPeak. They replied: "Thanks. Please confirm VAT lines and that ledger will show a credit memo if needed."
Tara (Finance): Canonical invoice includes VAT. I'll prepare credit memo CM-2026-03-0456 and link to their account; Ben will process refunds if requested.
Ben (Payments): Standing by. No refund required now.
Sam (Billing Eng): PR opened to make writer idempotent and to add a short lock around post-processing: https://git.redwood.ai/r/billing/+/pr/362. ETA deploy next maintenance window.
Tara (Finance): Please paste backfill/ledger confirmation here when done so I can close the support ticket.
Sam (Billing Eng): Backfill completed; ledger reconciled. Note added: "backfilled reserved_capacity and VAT lines for 2026-03-10033-RETRY; duplicate voided."
Tara (Finance): Thanks team. I'll post the credit memo and update the ticket; will send short RCA to the customer tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
